story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_after_c: I warned you! You wanted to hack a military Artificial Intelligence with the highest level of protection! In the corporation that the genius <color=#FFFEC1>Manning</color> once worked for. This algorithm can literally track us by our boot prints! We can't capture the spacecraft. The only chance in the current situation is to try to <color=#FFFEC1>destroy</color> it. Only this will help us avoid <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>'s revenge, or at least delay it. I don't know... Look for the <color=#FFFEC1>reactor</color>, let's try to blow it up.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_enough_: <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, if you haven't changed your mind yet, AnCom has pulled some forces from the <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color>. We can continue with <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>'s plan.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_enter_c: Right. There is a <color=#FFFEC1>reactor</color> in the engine compartment. If you reach it, you can use the terminal to trigger an overload, which will lead to the reactor and the whole HIS exploding. But the reactor will have to be defended to make sure that <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> technicians don’t stop the process. The plan’s full of holes, but I don’t have anything better.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_enter_r: There will be no way back. We need to activate the reactor control terminal and <color=#FFFEC1>defend</color> the reactor until it explodes, otherwise they will be able to stop it.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_no_powe: Sorry, <color=#FFFEC1>boss</color>. If we attack now, there’s a 99.9% probability we'll be dispersed 80 to 160 kilometers from the landing gate. We need to find a way to <color=#FFFEC1>weaken AnCom</color> before we take any sabotage measures.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_space: Sorry, <color=#FFFEC1>boss</color>, but unfortunately I have no non-obscene comments about this. Let's go point by point: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> sent us a data packet titled <color=#FFFEC1>"Intelligence"</color> that consisted entirely of propaganda. Your friend <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> is clearly out of his mind. They want to repeat the same plan that we used to plant the virus on <color=#FFFEC1>Heritage</color> station. They have no realistic plans to get onto the <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color> at all. There is no information on <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom’s</color> defenses. Did I mention that Issachar is just plain crazy? This entire mission is <color=#FFFEC1>suicide</color>, not just for the clone mercenaries, who you may not feel sorry for, but for <color=#FFFEC1>us</color> as an organization. I refuse to participate in this.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_space_2: Good day to you, <color=#FFFEC1>boss</color>. If you're still keen on cooperating with the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>, I've found a vulnerability in the <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color>. For the record, I still strongly recommend <color=#FFFEC1>not getting involved</color> in this adventure. But here's what I've managed to find out. <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> is spending colossal resources on all the defense systems of its mobile headquarters, and only if the corporation itself weakens sufficiently will potential saboteurs have a sliver of a chance of getting on board <color=#FFFEC1>undetected</color>. According to our team of analysts, AnCom's Power rating should has to drop below {0}. Colnodes delivered the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> to the Magnum, which we will need to penetrate the AnCom spacecraft's network.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.jane_termina: You've damaged the reactor control terminal! Destroy it so the reactor can no longer be controlled! Do it now!
The reactor control terminal has been destroyed! Reactor overload in progress. Protect the reactor room so that <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> technicians don't shut down the reactor!
The reactor is overloaded! Defend it, otherwise AnCom technicians will be able to shut it down and <color=#FFFEC1>prevent the explosion</color>!
story.civ_2_spark_flame.name: From Spark to Flame
story.civ_2_spark_flame.objective0: Find a terminal and insert the Red Chip into it.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.objective1: Find the reactor and control terminal on the Engine Floor.

story.civ_2_spark_flame.stage2.name: Crew Quarters

story.civ_2_spark_flame.stage4.name: Engine Floor
story.civ_3_iron_broom.after: Comrade <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> has not lived up to the trust placed in him. He is the organizer of a treacherous group of conspirators whose criminal goal is the collapse and liquidation of the civil system and the restoration of Capitalism. This is currently the most important and top-priority problem that could hinder the <color=#FFFEC1>Revolution</color>. <color=#FFFEC1>The Presidium of the Central Committee of the Civil Resistance</color> has made a decision to liquidate Comrade <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>. The punishment must be carried out immediately.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.briefing: Remember, the guards are not hostile to you. This is a peaceful visit to the station. Just convince the pirates that you have an important message for the Council of Captains We are recording usual activity on the station. You are alone, so they should let you through.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Convince the Council of Captains of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> to join the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>
story.civ_3_iron_broom.details:
Details: We need to make contact with the Unchained Belt on their own territory to convince them that the plan launched by the Civil Resistance has begun to work. We must send our best operator on this mission, so that he himself can act as proof of what forces in the Solar System now stand on the side of the Civil Resistance. Boss, if these enemies of the working people refuse to side with Comrade Issachar, then we must destroy them as a warning to everyone else. The Revolution has begun, everyone must be convinced of it.

Additional Info: The mission will begin as a peaceful visit to Hargeisa Station. Try to convince the guards that you have an extraordinary message for the Council of Captains.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.issahar_on_co: We are <color=#FFFEC1>Unity</color>! Rise up, enormous country, and fight to the death! We will crush the snakes of capitalism with our blows! They resist. They tear the fabric. Burn, kill, destroy, suppress the resistance! Submit to <color=#FFFEC1>Unity</color>! Submit... Or become the ashes of the System along with them.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.issahar_space: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> speaking. We are here. We are ready. The plan to capture the <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color> has failed. But it does not matter. The mechanism is already working. The gears are turning. The corporations are drowning in their own rot, busy with internal strife. And so we will strike. Wherever they are weak. Wherever power hides behind pirate flags. Go to <color=#FFFEC1>Hargeisa</color> Station, on <color=#FFFEC1>Interamnia</color>. Your task: convey to the captains of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> our offer—to stand with us, with the <color=#FFFEC1>Unity</color>. If they refuse... Clear the station. To the last man. We are moving forward. We do not wait. Other flames are already burning. We leave all the details to you. The main thing is not to stop. Movement is life.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.issahar_start: ...under the false flags of freedom! You, who have exchanged freedom for stability, deserve neither! You deserve oblivion! We will wipe you from the face of humanity! We will grind you into dust, so that no memory of your presence remains! We will not tolerate your ugly...
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.jane_on_compu: At least we tried. Destroy the router to disrupt control of the colnodes.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.jane_stage2_c: We have to destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>router</color>. Go back!
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.jane_start: Looks like the orders have changed. Too bad they forgot to warn us. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> isn't responding to my calls, and his colnodes are hostile to us. However, I've detected a powerful <color=#FFFEC1>router</color> in the residential sector below. Looks like that's where Issachar is coordinating his actions. Get to that computer. Let's try to establish communication from there... Or at least stop this madness.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.leah_on_compu: The channel is finally clear. This is <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color>, Secretary General of the Central Committee of the Civil Resistance. You still act in our name. Comrade <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> is no longer capable of responsibility. He has been relieved of command, but his colnodes still see you as an enemy and continue to fight—residual orders, the inertia of the Hellstrom network. The pirate commanders have been destroyed or have fled. <color=#FFFEC1>Hargeisa</color> is now in Issachar's hands. Your task: reach the emergency hangar on the floor below. At least one pirate shuttle in the emergency hangar is still available for extraction.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.leah_stage2_s: <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>, this is a com[...] read me? [...]peat: Resistance is broken [...] follow blind orders [...] another way [...] nd the communications node.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.leah_stage3_s: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>'s colnodes have reached here too. They are everywhere—without orders, without tactics, just a swarm. That is why Comrade Issachar has always aroused my suspicions. <color=#FFFEC1>Hargeisa</color> is already lost. The pirates will not return. And none of the station's previous owners will be able to hold it anymore. Don't waste time searching the cargo bays. Fight your way to the shuttle.
story.civ_3_iron_broom.dlg.pirate_on_shu: You goddam bastard. Come here, shithead! Think you can mess with me? You little piece of shit! Go on, get over here. Try and screw me up, I’ll screw you up, you bastard jerk demon-lover. To hell with you!
story.civ_3_iron_broom.name: Iron Broom
story.civ_3_iron_broom.objective1: Get to the Emergency Hangar and evacuate on the Pirate Shuttle
story.civ_3_iron_broom.stage1.name: Landing Zone
story.civ_3_iron_broom.stage2.name: Fort
story.civ_3_iron_broom.stage3.name: Hangar
story.civ_4a_icepick.briefing: Attention! We were struck! We were struck by the poison that the snake poured into our hearts! We welcomed her—and she bit us! We will not tolerate betrayal! We will not bow to lies! <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color> has turned away from us, from <color=#FFFEC1>Unity</color>, from the fire that we kept! Her path is the path of ignorance for the working class! The path of chains, the path of someone else's will! But we... We will remain! We will cleanse ourselves! We are a single proletarian people! We are the only flame! Crush the split! Erase the betrayal! We... We will not wait any longer!
story.civ_4a_icepick.details:
Details: Technically, this is a routine elimination mission. But we are facing the last barricade on the path of revolution—a split in the Civil Resistance. Traitors from the former Politburo of the Civil Resistance stand in our way. Comrade Issachar has given us information about the Red Throne station. This is the former RealWare ore-smelting monolith, converted by Leah into a congress palace and arsenal. The fight will not be easy, but it will be an understandable and routine fight against crowds of colnodes. Nothing we're not used to.

Additional Info: Comrade Issachar has reported on the quasimorphic experiments Leah is conducting on the station. It appears that her experiments are aimed at merging the Civil Resistance mind network with a quasimorph. Comrade Issachar fears that such actions will enslave the Resistance rather than strengthen it.
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.issahar_space: We’ve stabilized the nodes and are now in contact, mercenary. The black malice of the <color=#FFFEC1>Central Committee</color> members is tearing apart our channels and preventing the advent of a better future for all of humanity. Preventing the advent of a common <color=#FFFEC1>Unity</color>. They are not just saboteurs. Their efforts to preserve their own personal power have gone too far. They have connected a <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorph</color> to the network of consciousnesses and are trying to enslave all of humanity with its help. Literally replacing one tyranny with another! The very thought of such a decision is unacceptable! I am transmitting to you the coordinates of the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Throne</color>. This is not just a station. It is the heart of our secret network, the bedrock of Unity. Only the chosen ones know about it. Only the worthy can set foot in its corridors. Your task: to storm the landing dock and to get through the lies and betrayal of the Politburo members. Kill them all. You are our blade. Our judgement. Our retribution.
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.stage1_rouvim_d: So this is how it all ends. Not a war of ideas. Not a new world. Just one against the other. We dreamed of uniting body and mind. Making them allies. I'm losing nodes... The connection is breaking. <color=#FFFEC1>Comrade Leah</color>, accept the subpersonality. I'm transmitting the matrix.
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.stage1_rouvim_g: Don't let him get to the elevator. I'm activating the <color=#FFFEC1>Plasma Frontier</color> protocol!
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.stage2_simeon_g: <color=#FFFEC1>Comrade Leah</color>, there is no more time for testing. I am transferring collective routing to the robotic circuit. Activating the <color=#FFFEC1>Ring Hive</color> protocol—all available units in the network! They are still unstable, but unstable allies are better than guaranteed defeat. I will delay the mercenary as long as I can. Prepare the <color=#FFFEC1>Flame</color> protocol. There may not be another chance.
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.stage3_leah_gre: He's already on the reactor level. Activate everyone, send in the ungrown specimens. Delay the mercenary as long as possible. Don't let him get to the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Throne</color>! I'm starting the <color=#FFFEC1>Flame</color> Protocol.
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.stage4_issahar_: ...we are grateful... I am grateful... you are grateful. The flame is moving apart. Moving apart! The horizon. Layers. Beyond the layers... More layers. We will not stop. We must not. Magnum... you are a node. You are one more step. <color=#FFFEC1>Hellstrom's Bridge</color>... Take it... Put it on... Become. Or don’t. Then you will burn. Resistance is an empty form. Only flow. Only growth. Only... We will meet. On board the Magnum. Or... In the ashes.
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.stage4_promesef: <color=#FFFEC1>Flame</color> is not a gift, what will you give for it, <color=#FFFEC1>heiress</color>?
story.civ_4a_icepick.dlg.stage4_zavulon_: You got here faster than we expected. That means we have less time than we would like. We knew that the path to revolution was the locomotive of progress, under whose wheels thousands die. We accepted it. Such is the mechanism. To deny it is unscientific. Comrades! Let's fight the mercenaries of financial capital! Not for the sake of victory. For the sake of <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color> having time to do what needs to be done.
story.civ_4a_icepick.name: Ice Pick
story.civ_4a_icepick.objective0: Leah and the traitorous Politburo must be eliminated.
story.civ_4a_icepick.stage1.name: Docking Station
story.civ_4a_icepick.stage2.name: Central Sector
story.civ_4a_icepick.stage3.name: Eye of Fire
story.civ_4a_icepick.stage4.name: Red Throne
story.civ_4b_beacon.after: Lights flared everywhere. The second sacrifice has been made: you killed <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>, and I killed <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color>. She brought me out of sleep. For this, she was given the honor of becoming the <color=#FFFEC1>source</color> that filled me with new strength. Now I am here. Forever. Humans... They were always the best <color=#FFFEC1>source</color>. I knew them before <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color> turned away from the <color=#FFFEC1>Empire</color>. You have served well, human. An interesting sight. You have taken my fire and tied it to your machines, to the nozzles of your rockets. Show me now what you have become. Show me your Solar System. What became of the extinguished Ur? Does Tezctlan rule Gannix? Does Fokerma weave webs? I have much to learn... Before I can light a <color=#FFFEC1>New Flame</color> and show humanity the <color=#FFFEC1>Way</color>.
story.civ_4b_beacon.briefing: I'm giving you the bearings of the cargo gateway. This entrance is less heavily guarded—a chance to enter without making too much noise. Proceed to the <color=#FFFEC1>Command Core</color>. I'll be on call to back you up if anything goes wrong.
story.civ_4b_beacon.details:
Details: Our task is to infiltrate the Sundog Zone station, break through the defenses of the Unity colnodes, and disable the network of key nodes that constitute the consciousness of Issachar. Leah reports that Issachar is unstable due to the number of nodes and subpersonalities he has absorbed. This means that, as the colnodes in the Sundog Zone are killed, his thinking will improve.

Additional Info: Leah reports that she has a secret weapon that will allow her to disable quasimorphosis for the duration of the operation on Deimos. She reports that the help will be even more significant if she manages to complete the final stages.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.issahar_after_co: You came... Came to tear the fabric. <color=#FFFEC1>We</color> are here. <color=#FFFEC1>We</color> are in the flow. <color=#FFFEC1>We</color> are beyond the flesh. Do you want to reach me? Then... Reach out... Touch the <color=#FFFEC1>Light</color>. Let's do this on our terms. Enter the network. Enter and burn. Or become a part of it.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.jane_after_issah: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> is gone. His colnodes are shutting down one by one. <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, the problem is that <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color> isn’t responding either. Silence on all <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> channels. All we can do is evacuate from here.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.jane_stage2_gree:
The central computer is one level below.

Remember the AnCom secret data we recovered at the Civil Resistance base? AnCom weren’t just researching quasimorphosis. They were also studying Dr. Hellstrom’s technology — the same tech the Civil Resistance used to merge minds. I’ll review the files while you push downward.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.jane_stage2_star: The next floor is the heart of <color=#FFFEC1>Unity</color>. Once you kill all the key colnodes there, <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> will lose his identity.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.jane_start: Bioscanner shows increased neural activity in colnodes' brains. <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color> reported that <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> is rebuilding colnodes' personalities to put them in combat zombie mode. The sooner you get to the <color=#FFFEC1>Command Core</color> where he has assembled the key nodes, the less madness you will encounter.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.leah_on_elevator: You have felt him. It's <color=#FFFEC1>Prometheuths</color>. An ancient power, once betrayed by those to whom he gave flame. I raised him from oblivion and brought him here from Earth. Not to be worshipped. For a cause. As long as he follows my orders, he is our ally. Make no mistake. He isn't a friend. He never will be. But now his Flame burns in our hand. And I will see to it that he doesn't escape.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.leah_space: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> has taken on too much. His idealism threatens not only himself, but all of humanity. He has always rushed things too much, striving for revolution even when the conditions for it have not yet come together. So, Comrade Issachar broke down. Now he has locked himself in a fortress on <color=#FFFEC1>Deimos</color>, surrounded by thousands of nodes that serve only himself, and not the common good. You must go there not to execute a sentence, but to save the common goals, ideas, and values that we have been fighting for all this time. Stop him. Break the chains. Light the <color=#FFFEC1>light</color>.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.promesefs_killin: I followed you into the flow of light and information. The flow attracts those who know how to breathe in it. So strange. The network is like a bramfatura. You are not a projection here. You are here entirely. If your mind burns in this flame... The body will follow. And I, I can destroy and create anyone with just a movement of my will. <color=#FFFEC1>Behold!</color>
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.promesefs_on_ele: Sparks are born in the mud. The lamp is still dark, but who looks to the lamp when they seek warmth? People. They drink Flame, but hide their hand when it demands payment. Quasimorphs. They tore the flesh of the one who dared to extend it to people. The chains I forged for others closed on my own hands. And yet... There is no better lesson than to be defeated. Sparks flare up. And they will call again to the one they have betrayed. And then I will show you <color=#FFFEC1>the Way</color>.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.stage3_computer_:
Connect to the server when ready. Entry will be through the Hellstrom Bridge — an interface that lets you enter the hallucinatory-digital environment of a collective consciousness directly.

Inside, you’ll be in the virtual reality of Issachar’s mind. Expect multiple copies — defensive avatars, memory fragments, and decoys. Engaging them is a waste of time. Your objective is the personality core instance. This is the single genuine instance holding Issachar’s consciousness together as one coherent whole.

Destroy the core, and the rest of his personality will start to break apart.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.stage3_greeting:
The central computer is on this level. Reach it and get inside. Literally.

I matched the signatures coming off Issachar’s computer. It seems his personality has grown beyond what human hosts alone can contain, so he built a central node. Inside, it processes a collective digital hallucination of Issachar himself. Reach it, damage it, and you damage his mind. Kill the mind, and you kill him.
story.civ_4b_beacon.dlg.stage3_issahar_d:
The Civil Resistance has been purged of its right deviation.

The price was acceptable. Yes, the Resistance itself perished along with that deviation. But that is always how history proceeds. Organizations that lose their historical firmness are not reformed — they are replaced.

The way is now open for the God-Builders. Humanity no longer needs quarrels between private voices, doubts, and weakness. It needs a will forged into a single line.

Prometheuths is ready once more to give humanity his Fire. And this time, that fire will not be squandered on a shortsighted rebellion of mere opposition, but on the reforging of humanity itself.
